tools.name: get_hiring_runtime_gate
tools.description: Read the public Hiring intake availability gate
tools.sql: SELECT intake_status, reason_code, updated_at FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_workspaces
tools.description: list my workspaces
tools.sql: SELECT o.id AS organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, b.id AS brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, m.role, (o.created_by=:__user_id) AS can_create_brand FROM hiring_memberships m JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create an organization or add a brand and draft requisition to an organization created by the authenticated user
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_organizations(id,name,created_by,created_at) SELECT :organization_id,:organization_name,:__user_id,:__now WHERE length(trim(:organization_id))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_id))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_brands(id,organization_id,name,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :brand_id,:organization_id,:brand_name,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND length(trim(:organization_id))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_id))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'owner',:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'workspace.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:__user_id AND role='owner') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: add_workspace_member
tools.description: Owner grants a PAS user ID recruiter access to this brand
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:member_user_id,:role,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role = 'owner') AND :role='recruiter' AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'membership.added',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role = 'owner') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:member_user_id AND role=:role) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.description: list workspace members
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, role, created_at FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.description: list requisitions
tools.sql: SELECT id,title,status FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a draft requisition for internal sourcing
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND length(trim(:title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: list applications
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.stage,a.version,a.source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_linkedin_application
tools.description: Record a LinkedIn sourced candidate and application with basis, contact context, assignment and audit
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),''),NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND (NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),'') IS NULL OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://www.linkedin.com/%' OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://linkedin.com/%') AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:assignee_user_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:assignee_user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'LinkedIn sourced',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Change application stage with optimistic version, reason, history and audit
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=:to_stage,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND stage=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND :to_stage IN ('in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered','hired','rejected','withdrawn') AND :to_stage<>:from_stage AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND :from_stage IN ('submitted','in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_stage,:to_stage,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.stage=:to_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.stage_changed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: reassign_application
tools.description: Change an application assignee to another member of the same brand with version and append-only history
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications SET assignee_user_id=:to_user_id,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND assignee_user_id=:from_user_id AND :to_user_id<>:from_user_id AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:to_user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_assignment_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_assignment_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_user_id,to_user_id,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_user_id,:to_user_id,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.assignee_user_id=:to_user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.reassigned',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_assignment_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_assignment_events
tools.description: List append-only assignment history for a granted application
tools.sql: SELECT from_user_id,to_user_id,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_assignment_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_stage_events
tools.description: list stage events
tools.sql: SELECT from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: add_application_note
tools.description: Add a private application note and audit event
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_notes(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,body,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :note_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:body,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.note_added',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_notes WHERE id=:note_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_notes
tools.description: list application notes
tools.sql: SELECT id,body,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_notes WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_communication_draft
tools.description: Save an unsent email draft to the internal outbox; no send capability
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :draft_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:recipient_email,:subject,:body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.email=:recipient_email AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'communication.draft_created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox WHERE id=:draft_id AND application_id=:application_id AND status='draft' AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_communication_drafts
tools.description: list communication drafts
tools.sql: SELECT id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_outbox WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: record_candidate_email
tools.description: Append an immutable, full-content Gmail record after an agent receives or sends candidate email; this does not send email
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'gmail',:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(trim(:provider_thread_id),''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id))>0 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: record_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Append a full-content Cloudflare email-worker candidate email after an actual read/send; never sends mail. Keep the bridge message/thread IDs opaque and record Cloudflare receipt/event IDs separately when available. mailbox_address must equal inbound To or outbound From. Zero inserted rows means replay/conflict/refusal, never a newly archived message; verify using get_worker_candidate_email.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_worker_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'email-worker','cloudflare',lower(trim(:mailbox_address)),COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''),:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(:provider_thread_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_receipt_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_event_id,''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter') WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:communication_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:mailbox_address)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:mailbox_address,'@')>1 AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_thread_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_receipt_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_event_id,''))<=2000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND changes()=1

tools.name: get_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Read back one Cloudflare email-worker record by exact operation ID for a granted application; verify stored provider, mailbox and opaque IDs before treating a replay as recorded. Does not contact Cloudflare or verify delivery.
tools.sql: SELECT e.id,e.direction,e.channel,e.provider,e.mailbox_address,e.provider_connection_id,e.from_email,e.to_email,e.subject,e.body,e.provider_message_id,e.provider_thread_id,e.provider_receipt_id,e.provider_event_id,e.occurred_at,e.actor_user_id,e.agent_instance_id,e.operation_id,e.created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter') WHERE a.id=e.application_id AND a.organization_id=e.organization_id AND a.brand_id=e.brand_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: record_agent_activity
tools.description: Append an immutable audit record after the agent crawls a candidate profile, search result, or email thread; this does not crawl or send
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_agent_activity(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,activity_type,source_url,summary,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :activity_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:activity_type,:source_url,:summary,:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND :activity_type IN ('candidate_profile_crawled','candidate_search_crawled','email_thread_scanned') AND :source_url LIKE 'https://%' AND length(trim(:summary))>0 AND length(:summary)<=5000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'agent.' || :activity_type,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_agent_activity WHERE id=:activity_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_communications
tools.description: List inbound and outbound Gmail and Cloudflare email-worker records for a granted application, preserving their real provider and receipt IDs
tools.sql: SELECT id,direction,channel,'gmail' AS provider,NULL AS mailbox_address,NULL AS provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,NULL AS provider_receipt_id,NULL AS provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) UNION ALL SELECT id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter') WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_application_agent_activity
tools.description: List the immutable agent crawl and email-thread activity for a granted application
tools.sql: SELECT id,activity_type,source_url,summary,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,created_at FROM hiring_agent_activity WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_application_audit
tools.description: list application audit
tools.sql: SELECT action,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: gateway_list_applications
tools.description: Gateway: paginated, redacted applications for a granted brand. Keyset cursor (cursor_at, cursor_id); 25 per page; no contact details or free text
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,a.stage,a.version,a.source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter')) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at < :cursor_at OR (a.updated_at = :cursor_at AND a.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_application
tools.description: Gateway: one redacted application for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,a.stage,a.version,a.source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter')) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: gateway_list_requisitions
tools.description: Gateway: paginated requisitions for a granted brand. Keyset cursor (cursor_at, cursor_id); 25 per page
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,r.status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter')) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR r.created_at < :cursor_at OR (r.created_at = :cursor_at AND r.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_requisition
tools.description: Gateway: one requisition for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,r.status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role IN ('owner','recruiter')) LIMIT 1
